threat_summary: Backup or recovery services are stopped unexpectedly.
key_behaviors: recovery, backup, or shadow copy capability is modified
change occurs shortly before suspicious file activity
multiple hosts or critical servers may be affected
hunt_checklist: Search relevant telemetry for: recovery, backup, or shadow copy capability is modified.
Search relevant telemetry for: change occurs shortly before suspicious file activity.
Search relevant telemetry for: multiple hosts or critical servers may be affected.
Correlate activity by user, host, source IP, destination, and time window.
Confirm whether the behavior is expected business activity before escalation.
correlation_logic: Correlate alert evidence across listed telemetry sources within the same user, host, source IP, destination, and 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when backup service stopped is confirmed on a real user, host, workload, or production asset and the behavior cannot be explained by approved business activity.
